import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path.cwd()
OUT = ROOT / "artifacts/hs0002-20260910"
metadata = json.loads((OUT / "v1-cli.json").read_text())
raw = ROOT / metadata["raw_original"]
assert hashlib.sha256(raw.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == metadata["raw_sha256"]
removed = []


def scrub(value):
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        result = {key: scrub(item) for key, item in value.items()}
        if value.get("type") == "thinking" and "signature" in result:
            signature = result.pop("signature")
            digest = hashlib.sha256(signature.encode()).hexdigest()
            result["signature_sha256"] = digest
            removed.append(digest)
        return result
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return [scrub(item) for item in value]
    return value


lines = []
response = None
for line in raw.read_text().splitlines(keepends=True):
    try:
        record = json.loads(line)
    except json.JSONDecodeError:
        record = {"type": "raw_cli_line", "text": line}
    if record.get("type") == "result":
        response = record.get("result", "")
    lines.append(json.dumps(scrub(record), ensure_ascii=False))
public = "\n".join(lines) + "\n"
parts = [public[index:index + 180000] for index in range(0, len(public), 180000)]
part_names = []
for index, part in enumerate(parts, 1):
    name = f"v1-cli-public.part{index:02d}.json"
    (OUT / name).write_text(json.dumps({"part": index, "parts": len(parts), "text": part,
                                      "sha256": hashlib.sha256(part.encode()).hexdigest()}, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
    part_names.append(name)
assert "".join(json.loads((OUT / name).read_text())["text"] for name in part_names) == public
(OUT / "v1-cli-public-map.json").write_text(json.dumps({"original_path": metadata["raw_original"],
    "original_sha256": metadata["raw_sha256"], "public_sha256": hashlib.sha256(public.encode()).hexdigest(),
    "records": len(lines), "removed_only_thinking_signatures": removed, "parts": part_names}, indent=2) + "\n")
if response is not None:
    (OUT / "v1-response.md").write_text(response + "\n")
print(json.dumps({"parts": len(parts), "records": len(lines), "signatures_removed": len(removed),
                  "authored_verdict_exists": (OUT / "v1-verdict.md").exists()}))
